Build prompt

Build “Community Garden Plot & Harvest Log” on NeoApps for a community garden coordinator. Assign watering duties by plot and record harvested quantities and surplus offers. Use invitations and scope records to this group. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

Log 5 kg and 3 kg for one plot. Its total is 8 kg and a surplus offer appears once.
